experiments.scope: Once per organizer request, decode hash-bound plan data, independently rebuild P, G, B1 through B8, E and PD, require every packed-block hash and per-op count, require 60332 stored instructions and 147252 executed operations, and execute the exact schedule on eight fixed full-width points against a separate scalar Keccak reference. Then, for each organizer seed, derive 17 points, run four scalar chain steps and inspect 68 images for a low-12-bit agreement.
experiments.hypothesis: If the 68 projected images are independent uniform 12-bit values, a trial succeeds with probability 1-prod_(i=0..67)(1-i/4096)=0.4283525380. A returned pair is independently recomputed by the organizer as two distinct complete 128-byte messages with the declared 12-bit digest agreement. Null trials remain in the output.
